items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: A cancelled check run superseded by a later-started run of the same name no longer counts as failing; the card's stated cause (PR 889/888) is reproduced from live check-run data.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Non-dict entries and runs without started_at fall back to the old behaviour (still counted), so unknown input never hides a failure.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Pure classifier over API data; names still pass through _sanitize_name; no new I/O.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Three new tests: superseded cancel ignored, latest cancel still fails, real failure never masked; existing 26 tests unchanged and green.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Two linear passes over at most 100 check runs.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Same module and style; no new file; function stays small.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the card payload shape is untouched.
